summary_1line: Arjuna vows to break through Drona’s forces and slay Jayadratha the next day, boasting that no power in the universe can prevent it.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna touches his weapons beside Krishna and swears that he will kill Jayadratha the next day even if all gods protect him.
Arjuna imagines the battlefield where his arrows from the Gandiva split warriors, elephants, and horses as blood pours across the ground.
Arjuna declares before Krishna that he will pierce through Drona’s battle line to reach and behead Jayadratha.
